name: NotebookLM Reimagined - Complete Build Kit 🛠️
description_md:
# What You Get

- 
3 Complete PRD Documents: The exact Vision Document, Project Specification, and Implementation Guide used to build the app from scratch - totaling 100+ pages of technical blueprints.

- 
28 Architecture Diagrams: Visual breakdowns of every system - RAG flows, audio/video pipelines, API architecture, settings injection, study materials generation, and more. Perfect for following along or building your own version.

- 
8 Prompt Templates: Battle-tested prompts for every phase - project kickoff, database setup, feature requests, UI feedback, quality control, bug fixes, and API integrations. Copy, paste, customize.

- 
Step-by-Step Implementation Phases: A checklist-driven approach that survives Claude Code context resets. Each phase builds on the last so you can pick up exactly where you left off.

- 
Complete Tech Stack Reference: Supabase schema, Gemini model mappings, FastAPI endpoints, Next.js frontend patterns - all documented with the reasoning behind each decision.

- 
API-First Architecture: Every feature is an endpoint. The web UI is just another client. Build automations in n8n, Zapier, or custom apps that hit your own NotebookLM.
